paragraphs.text: Nnanyielugo is a Silverquill student on Arcavios .

Nnanyielugo was a close friend of Zimone Wola and Amaka , showing camaraderie and enthusiasm for their friendship and ensuring they could all sit together at the café. They enjoy playful banter and teasing with the other two. They eventually felt distrust in the relationship with Zimone after her alleged affiliation with the Oriq , which shows a higher loyalty to Strixhaven 's principles than to the friendship with Zimone.

Nnanyielugo arrived at the Firejolt Café with Amaka , hugging Zimone , and settled into the conversation about their recent exams and college choices. They showed curiosity about the mystery package and expressed interest in Zimone's birthday gift. Their concern was evident when nudging Zimone back to the present, and when the friends expressed excitement about the Mage Tower game.

Nnanyielugo and Amaka prepared to leave for the Mage Tower game, urging Zimone to hurry so they could get good seats. Later, Nnanyielugo, Amaka, and Zimone bumped into each other, discussing their busy schedules and new colleges, and expressed excitement about catching up and maintaining their friendship despite their different paths. Nnanyielugo chose to become a student at Silverquill College, electing to go a different path and following other interests than Zimone and Amaka, who chose Quandrix and Prismari , respectively.

After the Mage Tower game, Nnanyielugo's relationship with Zimone changed due to a rumor circulating that Zimone might have joined the Oriq , a group opposed to Strixhaven. Dean Kianne and Dean Imbraham interrogated Zimone about her encounter with the Oriq leader, Extus Narr , but despite Zimone's innocence, the rumor affected her friendships. As a result, Nnanyielugo and Amaka began avoiding Zimone when they saw her at the Biblioplex .
